shipped.title: What the studio ships
shipped.characterNote: The character the studio ships, at each density it ships at. One skeleton across all four, which is what lets the shipped animations play on it without a guess.
shipped.characterWhere: Placed, it lands in the project’s internal store: no extra file in your own tree.
shipped.texturesNote: A grid and a checker, each at two densities. One tile is one metre, which is what lets you judge a scale and see a UV stretch.
shipped.texturesWhere: Placed, they land in the project’s internal store: no extra file in your own tree.
shipped.animationsNote: The motions the studio ships, playable on its own character and on an imported one whose skeleton is recognised.
shipped.animationsReachable: Nothing to place: they are already offered wherever a motion is chosen, and the game export bundles them. Copying one into the project would be a second copy of the same bytes buying nothing.
